description: A single narrow clock pulse is injected during a chosen clock cycle, causing exactly one register update to be skipped while all combinational logic continues to evaluate normally.

capabilities.target: any single register in the design
capabilities.effect: the targeted register retains its previous value for that cycle; all other registers update as usual
capabilities.injection_timing: attacker can choose any clock cycle to inject the glitch

assumptions: The glitch does not affect combinational logic evaluation.
Only one register update is skipped per injection.
The attacker can observe the system's output (access_granted) to determine success.
